defects.description: Multiple overlapping navigation bar iterations are stacked vertically on the canvas instead of a single clean design
Third iteration shows misaligned elements: 'Products' link and 'Sign Up' button are floating below the main baseline of the nav bar
Sign Up button lacks visible border radius or shadow styling typical of modern UI components
defects.location: Right side of each nav bar

defects.description: Small annotation text is overlapping with the third nav bar design, creating visual clutter

top_fixes: Remove the duplicate/overlapping navigation bar iterations and present only one final, polished version
Fix alignment in the selected design so all links and the button sit on the same horizontal baseline
Add subtle border-radius (e.g., 4-6px) to the Sign Up button to match modern component standards

manifest.prompt: Create a website top navigation bar for a site called 'Acme': the logo text 'Acme' on the left, the links Home, Products, Pricing and About in the middle, and a 'Sign Up' button on the right.
